**package() function**: Copies `$srcdir/usr` into `$pkgdir/` (standard extraction of upstream binary package contents) and renames the license directory to match `$pkgname`. No operations outside the package directory.

No suspicious network requests, obfuscated code, dangerous commands (eval, base64, curl, wget), unexpected file operations, or any other red flags were found. The PKGBUILD is consistent with ordinary binary package distribution on AUR.
